name: Image With Text
description: This is a component combining an image with text

attribute_definitions.name: Subtitle Class
attribute_definitions.description: Add a class to override the default subtitle styles, e.g. 'text--yellow'. See the Style Guide for class options. Add 'custom' to remove other styles directly applied to this element.

attribute_definitions.name: Primary text class
attribute_definitions.description: Additional class(es) to add to the heading for styling purposes, e.g. 'h2 text--black mb-2'. Add 'custom' to remove other styles directly applied to this element.

attribute_definitions.name: Secondary text
attribute_definitions.description: Optional additional text placed below the display name.

attribute_definitions.name: Secondary text class
attribute_definitions.description: Additional class(es) to add to the secondary text for styling purposes, e.g. 'text--gray'. Add 'custom' to remove other styles directly applied to this element.

attribute_definitions.name: Button Action
attribute_definitions.description: To use this button to launch a video in a modal, enter the video's URL as an 'External' link type. YouTube, Vimeo and self-hosted MP4s are supported.

attribute_definitions.name: Button Style
attribute_definitions.description: Defaults to Primary button style

attribute_definitions.name: Text alignment
attribute_definitions.description: Only applicable if Text Placement is set to 'below image'.

attribute_definitions.name: Image
attribute_definitions.description: For faster load time, please use images under 500 KB.

attribute_definitions.name: Background Image Alt Text
attribute_definitions.description: Add alternative text for image, default is an empty string. See following to better understand what to write: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/images.html#alt

attribute_definitions.name: Container Class
attribute_definitions.description: Adds a custom class to the container. This can be used to set a background color for the component if there is no image selected. e.g. 'background--brand-secondary' See the Style Guide for more color options.

attribute_definitions.name: Background Video URL
attribute_definitions.description: Add a URL for a video to play as the background image. YouTube, Vimeo, and self-hosted MP4s are supported.

attribute_definitions.name: Play background video only when fully in view
attribute_definitions.description: If selected, the background video will not play until the entire component is visible in the viewport window. Default behavior is to start playing as soon as any portion is visible on the screen.

attribute_definitions.name: image size
attribute_definitions.description: Style used in this field if the image needs to be sized up or down. example '80%', 'cover', or 'contain'. Default is 'cover', which will scale the image up to fill the container.

attribute_definitions.name: Aspect ratio
attribute_definitions.description: Choose a shape for the Category Tile. Default is square.

attribute_definition_groups.name: Animation Options
attribute_definition_groups.description: Animations are applied to each text element.

attribute_definitions.name: Text Animation
attribute_definitions.description: Select an option below to animate in the text elements when this component is scrolled to on the page.

attribute_definitions.name: Text Animation Duration
attribute_definitions.description: Choose a duration for the animation to travel. Default is Medium. Short will make the animation more subtle and Long will make it more extreme.

attribute_definitions.name: Subtitle Animation Delay
attribute_definitions.description: Enter a number (in milliseconds) for the animation delay. Default is 300.

attribute_definitions.name: Primary Text Animation Delay
attribute_definitions.description: Enter a number (in milliseconds) for the animation delay. Default is 300.

attribute_definitions.name: Secondary Text Animation Delay
attribute_definitions.description: Enter a number (in milliseconds) for the animation delay. Default is 300.

attribute_definitions.name: Buttons Animation Delay
attribute_definitions.description: Enter a number (in milliseconds) for the animation delay. Default is 300.

attribute_definitions.name: Play Text Animation Once Only
attribute_definitions.description: If selected, the animation will not reset when the user scrolls back to the top of the page.

attribute_definitions.name: Disable Mobile Animation
attribute_definitions.description: If selected, animation will only occur on desktop (lg breakpoint and up).
